headline: 890 G/T SILVER OVER 51 METRES: Aya Gold hits record-grade polymetallic intercept at Morocco's Boumadine expansion
snippet: Aya Gold & Silver reported hole BOU-DD25-745 cutting 890 g/t AgEq over 51.5m at its Boumadine project in Morocco, including 1,504 g/t AgEq over 19.3m, while a parallel structure 70m below the current pit shell was intersected — a zone that could add new open-pit resources ahead of the 360,000m infill program.

headline: COPPER LOCKS IN $5.55: Chile's Cochilco raises 2026 forecast as energy transition demand floor holds firm
snippet: Chile's state copper commission Cochilco raised its 2026 copper price forecast to $5.55/lb and sees $5.10/lb in 2027, citing structural demand from EVs, AI data centres, and grid build-out — even as a small supply surplus of 12,000 tons is expected this year after a 124,000-ton deficit in 2025.

headline: WITHIN 200M OF THE PIT: Troilus West Rim hits 2.92 g/t AuEq over 19m outside resource — analysts flag M&A signal
snippet: Troilus Mining expanded its West Rim Zone with hole WR-26-016 returning 19m at 2.69 g/t Au — entirely outside the existing resource and within 200m of the feasibility-stage North Reserve Pit at its Quebec copper-gold project, with analysts noting the results strengthen the case for an acquisition bid.

headline: GOLD BREAKS $4,500: Safe-haven role questioned as oil-driven rate fears dominate precious metals selloff
snippet: Gold dropped below $4,500 for the first time since late March as rising real interest rates — not geopolitical risk — emerged as the dominant price driver, with analyst Edward Meir noting that 'a multi-country rise in real rates is really weighing mostly on gold' amid an oil-price-driven inflation shock.

headline: ATHABASCA DRILLS TURN: Skyharbour launches RL uranium program targeting high-priority conductors in Saskatchewan
snippet: Skyharbour Resources has mobilized to the South Russell target area at its 53,192-hectare RL Project in Saskatchewan's eastern Athabasca Basin — adjacent to Denison's Wheeler River — with a 4,000–5,000m program in 10–14 holes testing discrete EM conductors alongside joint-venture partner Denison Mines.

headline: 15 G/T GOLD OVER 20 METRES: NexGold expands high-grade Goldlund zone at Ontario's Goliath Gold Complex
snippet: NexGold Mining drilled 15.21 g/t Au over 20.1m, 5.11 g/t Au over 21.8m, and 4.51 g/t Au over 21.9m at its Goldlund deposit in northwestern Ontario, adding to the scale of the Goliath Gold Complex ahead of ongoing mine permitting.

headline: 93 G/T SILVER, 27 METRES WIDE: Prince Silver adds third rig in Nevada as polymetallic intercepts stack up
snippet: Prince Silver Corp returned 27.43m grading 93.7 g/t Ag, 12.0% Mn, 2.29% Pb, and 2.48% Zn in hole PRC-45 at its Pioche District, Nevada project, including 12.19m at 130.1 g/t Ag — and mobilized a third RC drill rig to accelerate the ongoing 9,000m program.

headline: SOUTH DAKOTA INFILL CONFIRMS: Dakota Gold hits 1.49 g/t Au over 38.1m at Richmond Hill with 85% of season done
snippet: Dakota Gold's 2026 Richmond Hill infill campaign returned RH26C-387 at 1.49 g/t Au and 8.13 g/t Ag over 38.1m in the Black Hills of South Dakota, with 92 holes and 13,718m drilled to date — a resource update expected in conjunction with 2026 feasibility advancement.

headline: 38M AT 2.23 G/T GOLD IN PNG: Great Pacific Wild Dog Kavasuki target grows along 15km epithermal corridor
snippet: Great Pacific Gold's 2026 drilling at the Kavasuki target on New Britain Island, Papua New Guinea, cut 38.4m at 2.23 g/t AuEq from surface in hole KVH-03, adding to the Wild Dog Project's 15km structural corridor that geophysics surveys indicate extends beyond 1,000m depth.

headline: VAULT ZONE CONFIRMED: Talon Metals' new Tamarack assays extend high-grade nickel-copper footprint in Minnesota
snippet: Talon Metals released six new high-grade Vault Zone drill holes at its Tamarack nickel-copper-cobalt project in central Minnesota, confirming mineralization geometry and continuity as the company evaluates the scale of a system tied to a Ford Motor Company battery supply chain agreement.

headline: DEBT CRISIS TRIGGER: Michael Oliver warns gold and silver are approaching historic breakout as bond markets crack
snippet: Veteran momentum analyst Michael Oliver of MSA Research told Money Metals Exchange that a global government debt crisis — not a mortgage-style shock — is the real trigger brewing for gold and silver, and that silver's momentum signals point to an eventual target of $300–$500/oz once the breakout ignites.
